title: No Land (Endless Void)
subtitle: Terminal velocity descent on twin light rails
description: Inspired by A. L. Crego (@ALCrego_ / "· No land ·"). A glowing human figure plummets endlessly through a deep vertical abyss, suspended by two razor-sharp rails of light while thousands of cosmic particulate streaks rush upward at blinding terminal velocity.

parameters.label: Descent Velocity
parameters.description: Speed of upward rushing cosmic particle streaks

parameters.label: Void Trench Width
parameters.description: Half-width of the dark vertical chasm

parameters.label: Light Rail Radiance
parameters.description: Bloom intensity of the twin parallel light cables and figure aura

parameters.label: Star Streak Density
parameters.description: Count of high-speed cosmic particulate streaks

parameters.label: Wind Turbulence
parameters.description: Aerodynamic flutter of the figure's body and limbs

mathNotation: x(side, u) = x_c \pm \left(w_{\text{void}} + (W - w_{\text{void}}) u^{2.2}\right), \quad y(t) = (y_0 - v_{\text{terminal}} t) \bmod H
formulaCompact: x = xc ± (w_void + dist * u^2.2), y -= v * dt
formulaFull: streakLen = len * speedMult; ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y); ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y + streakLen);
